Retire.js detected vulnerable/outdated client-side library 'jQuery' (version 1.10.2). 3rd-party CORS XSS via $.parseHTML() and Prototype Pollution via jQuery.extend(true, {}, ...). jQuery 1.x and 2.x are End-of-Life and no longer receiving security updates. Remediation: Upgrade to jQuery 3.7.1 or newer.
findings.evidence:
Component: jQuery v1.10.2
Detected via: URL Path
Identified in: App_Themes/Theme/assets/js/libs/jquery-1.10.2.min.js
Known CVEs: CVE-2015-9251, CVE-2019-11358
Recommended: Upgrade to jQuery 3.7.1 or newer.

findings.description: Retire.js detected vulnerable/outdated client-side library 'Bootstrap' (version 3.1.1). Multiple XSS vulnerabilities in data-target, tooltip (data-viewport, data-container), affix (target property), and collapse (data-parent) plugins. CVE-2024-6485 allows XSS via data-* attributes even in newer 3.x builds. Bootstrap 3.x is End-of-Life and no longer receiving maintenance or security patches. Remediation: Upgrade to Bootstrap 4.6.2+ or 5.3.3+.
findings.evidence:
Component: Bootstrap v3.1.1
Detected via: File Content (Banner)
Identified in: App_Themes/Theme/bootstrap/js/bootstrap.min.js
Known CVEs: CVE-2016-10735, CVE-2018-14040, CVE-2018-14042, CVE-2018-20676, CVE-2018-20677, CVE-2024-6485
Recommended: Upgrade to Bootstrap 4.6.2+ or 5.3.3+.

findings.description: Retire.js detected vulnerable/outdated client-side library 'Lodash' (version 2.0.0). Critical Prototype Pollution in _.merge(), _.defaultsDeep(), and _.zipObjectDeep() methods. Attackers can overwrite Object.prototype properties, leading to DoS or RCE. Remediation: Upgrade to Lodash 4.17.21 or newer.

Recommended: Upgrade to Lodash 4.17.21 or newer.

findings.description: Retire.js detected vulnerable/outdated client-side library 'jquery-validation' (version 1.11.1). Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) in URL and URL2 validation methods. Attacker-supplied input can cause catastrophic backtracking, stalling the browser. Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability via showLabel — error messages are injected into the DOM without sanitization. Remediation: Upgrade to jquery-validation 1.20.0 or newer.

Recommended: Upgrade to jquery-validation 1.20.0 or newer.
